title: Formalizing inverse problems in the age of AI: possibilities, pitfalls, and an invitation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proof assistants such as Lean check mathematical proofs down to the axioms, and AI agents have recently made writing such proofs cheap. We describe AutoIP, a Lean library in which classical linear regularization theory, together with the functional analysis it rests on, has been autoformalized by AI agents. A machine-checked proof certifies only the formal statement it proves, so the remaining human task is to confirm that each formal statement says what was intended. We organize the library around this task: a reviewer compares the formal statements with their natural-language counterparts and never needs to read a proof. Our experience is that the risks lie in the statements rather than in the proofs, and that simple automated tests on the statements can expose problems even in the established literature. We illustrate this with a textbook theorem whose hypothesis is more restrictive than asserted. We invite the inverse problems commun

translated_title: AI时代的反问题形式化：可能性、陷阱与一份邀请
translated_abstract: Lean等证明助手能够将数学证明验证至公理层面，而近来AI智能体使得撰写这类证明的成本大为降低。我们介绍了AutoIP，这是一个Lean库，其中经典的线性正则化理论及其所依赖的泛函分析已由AI智能体自动形式化。经过机器验证的证明只能担保其所述的形式化陈述本身，因此剩下的人类任务是确认每个形式化陈述确实表达了原本的意图。我们围绕这一任务来组织该库：审阅者只需将形式化陈述与其自然语言对应内容进行比对，而完全无需阅读证明。我们的经验是，风险在于陈述而非证明，并且对陈述进行简单的自动化测试甚至能够暴露已确立文献中的问题。我们用一个教科书定理来说明这一点——该定理的假设条件实际上比所声称的更为严格。我们邀请反问题领域的研究者……
tldr: 本文介绍了AutoIP——一个由AI智能体将经典线性正则化理论及其泛函分析基础自动形式化的Lean库，指出形式化的风险主要在于陈述而非证明，审阅者只需核对陈述与原文即可，且对陈述的简单自动化测试甚至能发现已发表文献中的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AutoIP, a Lean library in which classical linear regularization theory and its functional analysis foundations have been autoformalized by AI agents, showing that the risks lie in formal statements rather than proofs—reviewers need only verify statements against their natural-language counterparts, and simple automated tests on statements can expose flaws even in established literature.
